name: Isaberrysaura
isnote: Described as a basal neornithischian (Salgado et al. 2017); later analyses (Hui et al. 2022; Sánchez-Fenoll 2025) place it among the stegosaurs.
sum: Isaberrysaura is a stegosaur from the Middle Jurassic of Patagonia, notable for an unusual deep skull and heterodont teeth.
wsnote: Estimate given in the cited Wikipedia revision for the single known individual.
holotype: MOZ-Pv 6459, a partial skeleton with a nearly complete skull — Los Molles Formation, Neuquén Basin, Argentina.
material: Only the holotype is known; the postcranial material was still unprepared when described.
biology: Premaxillary teeth are recurved and the maxillary and dentary teeth lanceolate; similar dentition in living iguanid lizards goes with omnivory, so it may have been omnivorous.
author: Salgado et al. 2017
